item.title: Summer surprise: Thunderstorms, flooding hit Israel
item.description: Unseasonable rain swept parts of Israel, with 18.4 mm falling in Maaleh Adumim, flooding in Jerusalem, and key highway temporarily closed amid fears of flash floods.

item.title: Man charged with hate crimes after synagogue attack in NYC
item.description: A Bronx man faces hate crime charges after disrupting Shabbat services at Manhattan’s Central Synagogue, injuring a woman and attacking a security guard.

item.title: Hamas plants bomb under IDF tank in Gaza ceasefire violation

item.title: Three IDF soldiers injured by explosive drone in Lebanon
item.description: Explosive drone launched towards IDF forces injures three soldiers, prompting attack on Hezbollah battalion commander Ali Samir Al-Haj Hassan.
